title: Highlighting
text: {{ }}, {{{ }}} and template logic coloured as JavaScript. Component tags coloured like classes. CSS and JS inside style and script blocks.

title: Components
text: Type < to get your components, a space to get their props. Cmd/Ctrl+Click a tag to open its file. Hover to see the props it reads.

title: Data suggestions
text: data., item., props. and loop variables list real keys and values from your data files. Cmd/Ctrl+Click jumps to the key.

title: Real errors
text: Alo checks the project as you type, without saving. You see the same errors and hints as node alo build.

title: Quick fixes
text: Rename a misspelled tag or prop, create a missing component, wrap an element in template if, add a missing slot.

title: Pages and layouts
text: Each page shows its URL and a button to open it. Tabs read about (page) instead of a row of page.alo.
